name: How Los Angeles Interior Painters Should Handle Lead and Old Paint Safely

mainEntity.name: How do Los Angeles County interior painters handle lead paint and old coatings in pre-1978 homes without causing major dust and disruption?
mainEntity.text: How do Los Angeles County interior painters handle lead paint and old coatings in pre-1978 homes without causing major dust and disruption?

acceptedAnswer.text: In pre-1978 Los Angeles County homes, interior painters need a specific plan for dealing with potential lead-based paint and brittle old coatings. Ask whether they test suspect surfaces with lead check kits or partner with certified inspectors. If lead is present or likely, they should avoid aggressive dry-sanding, grinding, or open-flame removal, and instead use wet-sanding, scraping with minimal dust, or controlled chemical stripping. Containment is critical: they should seal off work areas with plastic sheeting, cover floors and furniture, and create taped zipper entries if large areas are being addressed. A HEPA-filter vacuum should be used during and after prep to capture fine dust, especially around baseboards, window trim, and radiators. Ask about their daily cleanup procedure and whether they perform a final wipe-down of horizontal surfaces. Clarify how they dispose of debris and removed paint chips. You can also request that they schedule the most disruptive work while you are out of the home and focus on one or two rooms at a time. Painters who can clearly explain their approach to older coatings, including crackled or alligatoring layers, and dust control measures will be better at preserving indoor air quality and reducing disruption, especially if you have children or pets.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professional Los Angeles interior painters should test for lead on pre‑1978 surfaces and use containment, HEPA vacuuming, and wet-sanding or chemical stripping instead of aggressive dry-sanding. Ask if they follow EPA RRP practices, how they seal rooms, and how they clean up daily so dust and disruption stay minimal.
